basic_info.headline: Microsoft Certified Partner ☁ Microsoft Power Platform Developer ☁ Microsoft Dynamics 365 Developer ☁ Microsoft Azure ☁ Microsoft Surface for Business Authorized Reseller
basic_info.about:
Enterprise Architect and Microsoft Cloud Solutions Provider with 21+ years leading architecture, modernization, and AI-driven automation across Finance, Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, and SMB sectors. Proven ability to architect complex cloud ecosystems, led multi-team development efforts, and deliver scalable, secure, high-impact automation solutions using Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365. 

Strong business acumen and comfortable interacting directly with customers, stakeholders, and executives at all levels. Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Easily learns new technology and can quickly determine alignment of new technology within tactical and strategic vision. Proven ability to effectively manage constantly changing priorities across multiple simultaneous projects within fast-paced environments. 

Founder of Silverspryte LLC, delivering enterprise-grade cloud, automation, and AI solutions for commercial and government clients.

experience.title: Founder | Enterprise Solutions Architect / Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Cloud Architecture (Azure) • AI/ML Generative AI Pipelines • GitHub Copilot • Dynamics 365 • PowerShell • Power Platform (Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataflows, AI Builder, Generative Pages, Custom Connectors) • Automation • Data Architecture ETL • DevOps CI/CD

RECENT PROJECT WORK: 

• Designed and engineered an end-to-end cloud and generative AI pipeline for healthcare reinsurance loss bordereaux, combining Azure Functions for backend data processing with Azure Functions (PowerShell), Dataverse, Power Automate, Power Apps, AI Builder, and Generative Pages. Built a scalable multi-stage architecture for claim ingestion, normalization, AI batching, structured response aggregation, severity and reinsurance exposure modeling, reserve-risk analysis, and portfolio-level reporting delivered via a Model Driven App with Generative AI pages (code-first and low code) embedded on custom pages throughout. 

• Developed an Azure-based reporting automation platform that orchestrates scheduled and on-demand Power BI exports and securely delivers generated reports through Azure Storage, managed identity authentication, and callback-driven workflows, on a fully VNET enabled tenant with no public access points. Built with Azure Functions (PowerShell) and Automation Runbooks (PowerShell), the solution integrates Power BI APIs, resilient retry/error handling, operational monitoring, automated deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps. 

• Led the architecture and development of an enterprise digital operations platform leveraging Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Azure AD, and Microsoft 365. Engineered automation solutions for compliance management, recruiting, security clearance processing, onboarding, and personnel deployment, eliminating manual workflows, improving audit readiness, accelerating candidate-to-deployment timelines, and creating the operational foundation required to rapidly scale new contract and workforce requirements.

experience.description:
Responsible for all aspects of information technology operations, information security, systems architecture and development efforts.

Lead Application Development and DevOps teams to deliver innovative, cost efficient solutions following Agile methodologies and maintaining HIPAA, PCI, and SOC 2 compliance.

Leveraging the latest Microsoft technology to execute the following:
•	platform modernization and consolidation
•	decrease system complexity and eliminate down-time
•	improve customer engagement through email, chat (live person and chat bot), SMS, marketing analytics, surveys, etc.
•	establish or improve integration and collaboration experiences across departments

Leveraging Microsoft Dynamics 365, Office 365, PowerApps, Power BI, Flow, Azure Logic Apps and Cognitive Services to identify new opportunities such as:
•	Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) opportunities surrounding patient engagement
•	Sales and Customer Insights using advanced Cognitive Services and AI to deliver chat bot experiences to patients
•	Automated case creation and management for various patient journey scenarios

Hands-on design, development, and implementation of the following technologies:
Dynamics 365 for Sales Enterprise, Office 365, C#, SQL Server 2016/2017, SSIS, SSRS, Power BI, Azure SQL Database, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure DevOps, Git, AWS, Magento, .NET Authorize, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, Microsoft Flow, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft SharePoint Online, Microsoft AAD, ADFS, Microsoft Bot Framework, Azure Service Bus, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Event Grid, Dynamics 365 Portals
